let rec findUnique (remaining : List Int) : Int :=
    match remaining with
    | [] =>
      0
    | x :: xs =>
      let filtered : List Int :=
        filterlist x nums
      let count : Nat :=
        filtered.length
      if count ≠ 1 then
        x
      else
        findUnique xs
  findUnique nums
